messages:
maria: FYI follow-up from the latency postmortem — we need concrete owners and due dates for SLO/SLA updates + dashboard changes. recurring pattern on long-tail p95 spikes around prefix 'embed-'

devin: agree. saw burn in error budget last 48h was ~4.2% above target, mostly during small traffic bursts. https://metrics.redwood.internal/errbudget/embed-p95 :thinking_face:

lucy: can we get a short list of actionables? I can take dashboard work but need exact queries + alert thresholds.

tanvi: I'll own remediation for the batching misconfig that surfaced. plan: change max_batch_latency from 200ms -> 120ms in canary, monitor 24h, rollback if throughput drops >7%. target timeline: canary by EOD Thu, full rollout next Tue.

maria: assigning: tanvi -> batching config + canary; lucy -> dashboard + alerts; devin -> SLO update proposal + runbook edits. I'll coordinate comms with product.

devin: here's proposed SLO tweak: current SLO= p95 latency < 250ms, target 99.5%. propose split SLOs by route: /generate p95 250ms @99.5, /embed p95 180ms @99.0 (because embedding jobs are bursty). rationale in thread: short-tail vs long-tail separation. will post formal PR by tomorrow.

lucy: for dashboards, I'll add per-prefix p50/p95/p99, plus a new 'burstiness' panel (rolling stddev of QPS). alerts: create two alert levels:

- Warning: p95 > 220ms for 10m (ops slack)
- Critical: p95 > 300ms for 5m (pager)

I'll add queries and link to dashboards in the runbook.

maria: error budget note: embed route burned ~2.1% of monthly budget this week alone. If we don't cap burstiness or adjust routing, we'll hit SLA thresholds. Consider short-term fallback to smaller model variant during peak.

tanvi: noted. I'll add a fallback policy: route to embed-small when queue length > 100 and p95 > 250ms. implement in routing rules and test during canary.

devin: PR checklist for SLO change: 1) SLO doc update + motivation 2) Dashboard adjustments 3) Impact email to customers if SLA change 4) Meeting w/ support. aiming to ship Fri.

ops-bot: incident-17823 closed by tanvi. tags: latency, embed-route.

lucy: quick ask — can someone share the synthetic test that simulates the short burst pattern? want to add to CI.

maria: @devin created the load-test scripts in infra/tests/latency/burst_embed_test.sh last week. devin can you paste the command?

devin: sure: `./burst_embed_test.sh --qps 120 --burst 60s --payload-size 4kb` will reproduce. I'll add it as a nightly job for the embed route.

maria: recap of action items:

- tanvi: implement max_batch_latency change + fallback routing, canary by EOD Thu, full rollout Tue (owner)
- lucy: dashboard panels + alerts + runbook links, by Mon noon (owner)
- devin: SLO doc PR + add synthetic nightly job, PR by Fri (owner)
- maria: customer comms + SLA impact review, by Fri COB (owner)

please ack and update your PRs in the postmortem board. I'll tick off items in the next weekly SLO sync. :white_check_mark:

lucy: acked. starting dashboard edits now.

tanvi: acked. will post canary results in this thread.

devin: acked.
